summary: Iteration 91: Platform Analytics & Plan Limits Testing. All 19 backend tests passed. Frontend verified: Platform Analytics page shows KPI cards (MRR, Active Tenants, Trial Tenants, Total Users, WAU, Active Alerts), Plan Distribution bars with percentages, Signup Trend 30-day chart, Tenant Health table with plan/status badges and users/limit. Sidebar shows Platform Analytics link under SUPER ADMIN section. Fixed bug: create_tenant endpoint was missing 'request' parameter causing 500 error.

TEST_02_overview_section.notes: Response contains overview with mrr, mrr_formatted, total_tenants, active_tenants, trial_tenants, total_users, active_users, weekly_active_users, active_alerts

TEST_03_plan_distribution.notes: Response contains plan_distribution object with plan counts

TEST_04_tenant_health_sorted.notes: tenant_health array sorted by MRR descending, contains tenant_id, plan, status, users, max_users, mrr

TEST_05_signup_trend_31_days.notes: signup_trend has 31 days with date and count fields

TEST_09_create_test_tenant.notes: Created test tenant with starter plan (max 3 users)

TEST_10_add_users_within_limit.notes: Added 2 users to starter tenant (within 3 user limit)

TEST_11_exceed_limit_returns_400.notes: Adding 4th user returns 400 with limit exceeded message

TEST_13_user_limits_per_plan.notes: tenant_health shows correct max_users per plan (starter=3, professional=10, enterprise=999999)

TEST_14_mrr_values_correct.notes: MRR values match PLAN_MRR dict (starter=29000, professional=99000, enterprise=249000)

TEST_16_health_endpoint.notes: Health endpoint confirms app running (scheduler runs in background)

TEST_17_mrr_sum_matches.notes: Overview MRR equals sum of individual tenant MRRs

TEST_18_tenant_counts_match.notes: Overview counts match tenant_health list counts

STEP_09_plan_distribution_bars.notes: 4 plan bars: Trial (47%), Starter (33%), Professional (13%), Enterprise (7%)

STEP_11_tenant_health_table.notes: Table shows tenant_id, plan badge, status badge, users/limit, MRR, trial days, created date

STEP_12_sidebar_link.notes: Platform Analytics link found in SUPER ADMIN section

bugs_fixed.issue: create_tenant endpoint missing 'request: Request' parameter causing NameError and 500 response
bugs_fixed.fix: Added 'request: Request' parameter to function signature

critical_code_review_comments: Platform Analytics endpoint properly implemented with comprehensive data: overview, plan_distribution, tenant_health, signup_trend
Plan limits enforcement working correctly via check_plan_limit() function in core/plan_access.py
PLAN_FEATURES dict correctly defines limits: trial=999, starter=3, professional=10, enterprise=999999 users
PLAN_MRR dict correctly defines pricing: trial=0, starter=29000, professional=99000, business=199000, enterprise=249000
Trial expiration scheduler configured in server.py (_trial_expiration_scheduler runs every hour)
Frontend PlatformAnalytics.jsx properly displays all KPI cards with data-testid attributes
Sidebar correctly shows Platform Analytics link under SUPER ADMIN section
